rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Distinguish power (capacity) from authority (legitimate right) in definitions.
Analyse how texts show power misuse — through a character's decision, not description.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Politics passages use loaded language — separate FACT from OPINION; comprehension questions ask you to identify the writer's stance, so track evaluative words.  ·  Trick 2: 'Power corrupts' essay: define → one historical example → one modern example → safeguard (accountability, free press) — structure beats rhetoric.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: Q. Why do people abuse power? (2 marks) — lack of accountability and human greed; give one example.
